title: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists spectral type G2 V
summary: The Sun fact sheet's spectral-type row reads G2 V. Mass and radius are on the existing Sun card.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet, last updated 9 May 2024, lists spectral type G2 V. An earlier card on this sheet's mass and radius said a G-type label was not on the rows then read. The spectral-type row is on the page fetched 18 November 2026, and it reads G2 V. Mass, radius, and central temperature stay on the earlier card and are not repeated here.
